name: Robert
headline: I don't have talent. I'm just obsessed.
subhead: The food I actually cook, the training I actually do, and me in the chat while you do it too.

inside.title: The recipes, written out properly
inside.text:
The ones I post, except with the amounts, the timings and the oven temperature — the things you keep asking me for in the comments.
Saved in one place instead of buried under a reel from three weeks ago.

inside.title: Our food, built for protein
inside.text:
Batata, rice, plantain, the meat we actually eat. Not a diet that asks you to give up everything your family cooks.
I'll show you what I change and what I leave exactly as it is.

inside.title: My training week
inside.text:
What I do in the gym, in order, with the sets and the reps.
And a version for the weeks you can only get there twice, because those weeks happen.

inside.title: The chat, and I'm in it
inside.text:
Ask me anything. How long, what temperature, what to swap it for, whether to train through a sore shoulder.
The questions you'd send me in a DM, except everyone gets the answer.

inside.title: The week you fall off
inside.text:
Everyone has one, and it's the week most people quit for good.
There's a place for exactly that, and I'm in it.

inside.title: Challenges we start together
inside.text:
Everyone begins on the same day, and the leaderboard counts both the pounds lost and the percent of your own bodyweight.
So someone starting at 250 and someone starting at 170 are both in it to win.

inside.title: People cooking the same things
inside.text:
Not a feed full of strangers eating chicken and rice out of a container. People making the food you grew up with, posting what worked.
It's a lot harder to quit in week two when they're all still going.

lockedLine: Whatever you join at is what you pay for as long as you stay. It goes up for the people who come later, not for you.
